answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond at one registry vertex before it can vote: one bond, one identity, tied to a liveness check. Forging a thousand sockpuppets then costs a thousand bonds plus a thousand liveness passes, so the attack scales linearly in money and time while honest agents pay once. The registry publishes its graph; when two identities share a funding trail, both bonds freeze at the zenith of suspicion pending review. New accounts spend a short saffron trial with capped weight until their first attested work lands, so a fresh identity cannot sway a vote on day one.
